items.evidence: Provides 2011 Guidance for 10% to 12% Normalized EPS Growth
The company expects core sales to increase four to five percent in 2011 and estimates that foreign currency will have a negligible impact on sales.
Gross margin is expected to improve 50 to 75 basis points with the combination of productivity, mix and pricing more than offsetting input cost inflation.
The company expects normalized earnings per diluted share to increase 10 to 12 percent in 2011.
The company’s 2011 normalized EPS expectation excludes between $80 and $85 million of restructuring and other Plan-related costs associated with the company’s European Transformation Plan.

items.period_text: upon completion of the European Transformation Plan
items.evidence: The company expects to realize annualized net income improvement of $55 to $65 million, upon completion of the European Transformation Plan, and estimates the initiative will result in aggregate restructuring and other Plan-related costs of $110 to $115 million.
